name: com.basis.rtao
description: Ray traced ambient occlusion for URP, built on Unity's Unified Ray Tracing backend. Traces cosine-distributed occlusion rays against a scene acceleration structure, denoises with reverse-reprojection temporal accumulation plus a separable bilateral filter, and publishes the result as _ScreenSpaceOcclusionTexture so every URP lit shader picks it up. Stereo aware end to end: one dispatch covers both eyes of a single-pass-instanced VR frame.
